subject.title: [Feature Request]: Multi-lane concurrency support for sub-agents via sessions_spawn

question: Should OpenClaw expose caller-selected `sessions_spawn` lanes and per-lane subagent concurrency config, and what exact lane naming/config shape should become the public contract?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix adds a model-facing tool parameter and a new config/default surface with scheduler semantics that should be chosen by maintainers before implementation.

options.title: Approve additive lane design
options.body: Add `sessions_spawn.lane` with validation, default-to-`subagent` compatibility, native/ACP forwarding, and an explicit per-lane concurrency config shape.

options.title: Defer to adjacent concurrency work
options.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers decide whether per-agent caps or queue-status visibility should solve the same user workflows instead.

options.title: Reject public lanes for now
options.body: Keep a single subagent lane and document `maxConcurrent`/workflow limits if exposing lane names is not a desired product contract.

recommendation.title: Approve additive lane design
recommendation.body: Add `sessions_spawn.lane` with validation, default-to-`subagent` compatibility, native/ACP forwarding, and an explicit per-lane concurrency config shape.

likelyOwner.reason: Most central current-history owner for sessions_spawn, subagent dispatch, and concurrency-resolution code.
